summary: Phase 3 external auto-sync testing completed. All backend sync endpoints (YouTube, AniList, TikTok, Prime) working correctly. Frontend pages render synced data without crashes. Circular carousel, sync panels, and manual sync buttons functional. Regression tests passed.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns sync_interval_seconds: 300
Backend: GET /api/admin/sync/status shows youtube, catalog:anilist, tiktok, prime, all states
Backend: POST /api/admin/sync/run with target youtube returns ok, 24 videos synced
Backend: POST /api/admin/sync/run with target anilist returns ok, 50 catalog items synced
Backend: POST /api/admin/sync/run with target tiktok returns ok, 1 video synced (best-effort)
Backend: POST /api/admin/sync/run with target prime returns degraded, 0 videos (expected - no public API)
Backend: GET /api/videos?platform=youtube returns MongoDB synced items with youtube-data-api-v3 source
Backend: GET /api/videos?platform=tiktok returns MongoDB synced items
Backend: GET /api/videos?platform=prime returns fallback items (degraded gracefully)
Backend: GET /api/catalog returns MongoDB source with AniList provider, 50 items, 14 genres
Frontend: /chaine-youtube page loads with hero iframe, sync status panel, manual sync button, 24 video cards
Frontend: Manual sync button on /chaine-youtube triggers sync and shows status 'Sync ok · 24'
Frontend: /tiktok page loads with sync panel and video grid without crashing
Frontend: /prime-video page loads with sync panel and video grid without crashing (fallback ok)
Frontend: /anime-catalog page loads with search input, genre select, source badge showing 'mongodb'
Frontend: /anime-catalog Sync AniList button present and functional
Frontend: /anime-catalog circular carousel renders with navigation buttons (prev/next) working
Frontend: /anime-catalog circular carousel detail panel shows anime info and trailer button
Frontend: /anime-catalog grid mode toggle works, showing 50 anime cards
Frontend: Floating Sync button present and clickable, triggers backend sync
Frontend: /admin page loads with sync status panel showing 5 sync states
Regression: /shop page loads with search input and 72 products
Regression: Cart drawer opens and closes correctly
Regression: /contact page loads with contact form
Regression: Mega menu opens correctly
No severe runtime errors in browser console
